caveats: Published total irrigation category only; the source also contains unimported irrigation-specific columns.
National totals and separately reported scheme areas are retained; they are not all additive. Source footnotes change Mahaweli/Udawalawe reporting into districts after 2017/18.

Source dashes remain null. Geography names are not silently forced onto present-day administrative boundaries. Sown area, harvested area, yield and production have different definitions and latest periods.
